sql: WITH RECURSIVE pk AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member), vd AS (SELECT dp.target AS target, dp.code AS code, m.label AS wg_meeting FROM disposition dp JOIN resolution r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id WHERE (lower(dp.evidence_status) LIKE '%verif%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%unverif%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%not%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%non%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%fail%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%pending%' OR lower(dp.evidence_status) IN ('source','confirmed')) AND (lower(dp.scope) LIKE '%whole%' OR lower(dp.scope) LIKE '%entire%' OR lower(dp.scope) LIKE '%full%' OR lower(dp.scope) IN ('document','doc','tdoc','all'))), revn AS (SELECT COALESCE(de.number, r.earlier) AS e, COALESCE(dl.number, r.later) AS l FROM revision r LEFT JOIN document de ON de.id = r.earlier LEFT JOIN document dl ON dl.id = r.later), startk AS (SELECT 'R1-2307027' AS k UNION SELECT id FROM document WHERE number = 'R1-2307027' OR id = 'R1-2307027' UNION SELECT number FROM document WHERE number = 'R1-2307027' OR id = 'R1-2307027'), chain(x, depth) AS (SELECT k, 0 FROM (SELECT k FROM startk) UNION SELECT revn.l, chain.depth + 1 FROM chain JOIN revn ON revn.e = chain.x WHERE chain.depth < 50), later AS (SELECT DISTINCT x FROM chain WHERE depth >= 1 AND x IS NOT NULL AND x NOT IN (SELECT k FROM startk WHERE k IS NOT NULL)), ld AS (SELECT later.x AS k, d.id AS did, d.number AS dnum, COALESCE(d.number, later.x) AS docnum FROM later LEFT JOIN document d ON (d.number = later.x OR d.id = later.x)) SELECT DISTINCT ld.docnum AS final_document, vd.code AS disposition, cp.pack_number AS cr_pack FROM ld JOIN vd ON vd.target IN (ld.k, ld.did, ld.dnum) JOIN pk ON pk.cr IN (ld.k, ld.did, ld.dnum) JOIN cr_pack cp ON (cp.id = pk.pack_id OR cp.pack_number = pk.pack_id)
